uncited: This method defines the data transfer and processing pipeline required to construct the SGGX-H (Hierarchical SGGX) representation from GPU-computed leaf node data.
It addresses the problem of converting high-frequency, GPU-resident SGGX distributions into a CPU-accessible hierarchical structure suitable for aggregation.

It is distinguished from pure GPU implementations by the explicit requirement to move leaf node histograms to the CPU to enable the generation of aggregated SGGX distributions, a step necessary for the hierarchical clustering logic described in [Hierarchical SGGX Aggregation](7833-hierarchical-sggx-aggregation.md).
*   **Output:** A CPU-resident SGGX-H representation, consisting of aggregated SGGX distributions and their hierarchical metadata.
Each distribution is characterized by its microflake parameters.
The method relies on a histogram representation of the SGGX distribution, which captures the directional transparency properties.
**GPU Fitting:** Compute the initial SGGX parameters for each leaf node voxel on the GPU.
**Data Transfer:** Transfer the GPU-computed histograms from the GPU memory to the CPU memory.
**CPU Histogram Generation:** On the CPU, generate a new histogram using the SGGX distribution itself.
**Representation Construction:** Use the CPU-generated histograms to build the SGGX-H representation.
No explicit mathematical formulas are provided for the data flow itself.

The method relies on the SGGX parameter fitting equations defined in [SGGX Parameter Fitting from Directional Transparencies](8203-sggx-parameter-fitting-from-directional-transparencies.md) and the aggregation logic of the parent method.
*   **Transfer Costs:** The requirement to move data from GPU to CPU incurs significant transfer costs.
*   **Leaf Node Optimization:** For leaf nodes, it is possible to use the original GPU-computed histogram instead of regenerating it on the CPU.
However, this requires moving the GPU-computed histogram data to the CPU, which still incurs transfer costs.
*   **Time Complexity:** The time complexity is dominated by the GPU-to-CPU data transfer and the CPU-side histogram generation.
The method is part of the SGGX-H rendering pipeline, which aims to provide fast voxelization and level-of-detail control for microgeometry rendering.
